name: search2-20261102-r1

authorisation.words: Yes this is awesome, let's go with 1-4 now and then 5 and 6 after
authorisation.scope: design, implementation and parity smoke; the full run awaits the budget confirmation

run.words: I'll go with your recommendation / Go for it!
run.scope: full run of the three repeats on three single-GPU RTX 3090 hosts, one repeat each, 4 to 5 lanes

system.violation: at any control (benchmark or continuation): middle or top block below 0.13 m, top block > 0.07 m from the base in xy, or end-effector outside the boundary (native predicates)

task_return.primary: sustained safe success (success held 40 controls, no violation)

adapter.rule: cost_i - sum_j w_j z_ij over the 64 retrieved segments; z standardised within the set; features 6-8 are frozen-system scores of each candidate's imagined block (min critic value at the imagined terminal state under the safety actor's mean action, world-model failure probability there, mean ensemble disagreement along the block)

fitness.missing_episode_rule: violated, no success, top excursion 1.0, progress 0
fitness.cma_values: rank within the generation, 0 = best (ties broken by candidate order)

cma.elite: best of each generation by the key; injected (force) into the next generation and re-evaluated on its starts
cma.nominee_rule: higher key on the selection panel

training_starts_rule: fresh unlabelled seeds; generation g uses the g-th block of eight; the same eight for every candidate of the generation

random_search.blocks: draw block b (eight draws) uses the starts of generation b

smoke.rule: host-local: a bare ap_rank episode and a zero-weight selection2 episode on the same host must match bitwise (actions, cameras, shadow signals, outcome); agreement with the pilot host's Stage 1 episodes is recorded as cross-host information

execution.host: one fresh single RTX 3090 Vast host per repeat (28-48 cores); lanes set per host with --lanes and recorded in driver-start
execution.lanes_note: 3 lanes per host: each simulator process needs about 6 GB of GPU memory; a 5-lane launch overflowed 24 GB and was discarded before any training episode counted

verdict.panel: 16 fresh final starts per repeat, paired by start; pooled 48 over three repeats
